### Known gaps

- dmsengine (2026-10-31, unverified against real DMS, recalled from the DMS User Guide only): the S3 target's CsvNullValue default (NULL), CDC file name pattern (YYYYMMDD-HHMMSSmmm.csv), Kinesis control-record shape under IncludeControlDetails, Kinesis partition key (schema.table) and JSON number/string value encoding, and the ISO/checkpoint forms accepted by CdcStartPosition. The SDK confirms only the settings member names, the TableStatistics and ReplicationTaskStats fields, TableState values and the StopReason strings.
- dmsengine scope: no object-mapping rules for Kinesis/DynamoDB; BeforeImageSettings (task-settings form), validation, LOB settings, CommitRate batching beyond batch size, parallel-load, CdcMaxBatchInterval, StopTaskCachedChanges*, TaskRecoveryTableEnabled and CreatePkAfterFullLoad are ignored. Table mappings: data-masking-* actions, table-tablespace/index-tablespace targets, table-type view and the tuple/set/list/map data types are rejected; expressions cover the documented SQLite subset (string, numeric, NULL-check, date/time without modifiers, hash_sha256, operation_indicator, CASE, the $AR_H_STREAM_POSITION/TIMESTAMP/COMMIT_TIMESTAMP/OPERATION/USER and $AR_M_SOURCE_SCHEMA/TABLE_NAME headers) and anything else (modifiers, $AR_H_CHANGE_SEQ, $AR_M_SOURCE_COLUMN_*, other functions) fails the task with an explanatory error. Unverified against real DMS (the User Guide is silent): a source-filter update that moves a row out of the filter is applied as a delete and one that moves it in as an insert (the guide only warns that filters on mutable columns misbehave); add-before-image-columns is documented for Kinesis and Kafka targets and is also allowed on S3 (undocumented); before-image columns hold the pre-update value on updates and deletes and NULL otherwise; define-primary-key with origin unique-index emits a named UNIQUE constraint and keeps it as the upsert key; change-data-type passes values through as text and relies on the target database to cast them; add-column results are cast to the declared data-type.
- dmsengine sources and targets: MySQL/MariaDB/Aurora-MySQL, PostgreSQL/Aurora-PostgreSQL and S3 (CSV) sources only (no Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB, S3 Parquet source files; ReloadTables is not rejected for S3 sources although the guide says they do not support it); SQL targets are the same two families plus S3 (CSV and Parquet), Kinesis and DynamoDB. S3 source: ExternalTableDefinition columns map ColumnType to the DMS type names, ColumnDateFormat values are rewritten to ISO, BYTE/BLOB fields are read as raw text bytes (the guide does not give the CSV encoding), full-load files are LOAD*.csv under bucketFolder/TablePath (TablePath defaults to schema/table), CDC files are every *.csv directly under bucketFolder/CdcPath applied in lexical order once each (a file that sorts before one already applied is skipped, as the guide says), the checkpoint is the last file key, and CDC rows carry no before image so S3-sourced updates are keyed on the new row. Secrets Manager endpoint credentials resolve for the MySQL/PostgreSQL settings blocks only (SecretsManagerSecretId plus the required SecretsManagerAccessRoleArn, secret members username/password/host/port; the role is checked for presence, not IAM-evaluated); the guide says clear-text and secret credentials are mutually exclusive but both are accepted here and the secret wins. DDL on the source is not replicated (a column-count change suspends the table with Table error). TLS is always verified: SslMode require/verify-ca/verify-full trust the endpoint's CertificateArn PEM (ImportCertificate) or the system roots and check the server name, and a failed verification fails TestConnection and the task with an explanatory message (require is not DMS's no-verify mode; verify-ca also checks the host name); PostgreSQL CDC reads test_decoding through pg_logical_slot_get_changes and cannot start from an arbitrary LSN or timestamp (changes since slot creation only), and the slot is dropped when the task is deleted.
- RDS Postgres docker instances start with wal_level=logical only when the instance parameter group (cluster parameter group for Aurora) sets rds.logical_replication=1 at create time, as real DMS users must; otherwise wal_level=replica and a PostgreSQL CDC task fails with 'wal_level is replica, logical is required'. Enabling it on an existing instance by ModifyDBParameterGroup plus reboot does not recreate the container, so the instance must be created with the group.
- DMS Serverless: replication configs run the same engine (StartReplication/StopReplication/ReloadReplicationTables, DescribeReplications ReplicationStats/StopReason/FailureMessages/RecoveryCheckpoint, DescribeReplicationTableStatistics). Unverified: ProvisionData.ProvisionedCapacityUnits reports ComputeConfig.MinCapacityUnits while running (the SDK says only 'the number of capacity units the replication is using'), no scale-up/down is simulated, ProvisionState is not set, and statuses are starting/running/stopping/stopped/failed only. LocalStack ENABLE_DMS=1 maps to DMS_ENGINE=docker; DMS_SERVERLESS_STATUS_CHANGE_WAITING_TIME and DMS_SERVERLESS_DEPROVISIONING_DELAY are not implemented (LocalStack documents the delays but not the observable deprovisioned state, and says table statistics are deleted after the replication finishes, which this engine keeps).
- DescribeApplicableIndividualAssessments: MigrationType/SourceEngineName/TargetEngineName do not narrow the catalog. The SDK doc says a partial set of these three cannot produce a list, but names no error and no per-engine support matrix (the real assessment names live only in the user guide), so narrowing or rejecting would be invention.
- ModifyReplicationInstance.ApplyImmediately/AllowMajorVersionUpgrade are undeclared: the SDK gives neither the maintenance-window application timing, the definition of a 'major' DMS version, nor the error for an unflagged major upgrade.
- DescribeEvents.Duration is undeclared: the pinned SDK doc gives no unit for 'the duration of the events to be listed', so applying a window would be invention.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- DescribeDataMigrationsInput.WithoutStatistics: DataMigration.DataMigrationStatistics is never populated because the engine only drives classic replication tasks, not DMS data migrations, so there is nothing to omit.
- StartReplicationInput.PremigrationAssessmentSettings is validated (JSON object, ResultEncryptionMode enum, IncludeOnly/Exclude exclusive), but the FailOnAssessmentFailure gate never trips: every individual assessment passes since no source/target connectivity exists to check.
- CdcStartTime on CreateReplicationTask/ModifyReplicationTask/StartReplicationTask: validated against CdcStartPosition but not stored, since types.ReplicationTask has no CdcStartTime member and the engine consumes CdcStartPosition only. StartReplication echoes CdcStartTime on the Replication.
